diff_summary: Added regression coverage for removed fields, types, and enum values in union branches; additive branches and equivalent renamed refs remain compatible. The comparator now checks union branches independently, preserves enum values, and detects circular refs.

verification.command: env APP_ENV=local PYTHONPATH=backend DATABASE_URL=postgresql://127.0.0.1:1/unreachable MONGODB_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:1 .venv/bin/pytest -q backend/tests/test_contract_snapshot.py backend/tests/test_contract_compat_unions.py && .venv/bin/ruff check backend/tests/contract_compat.py backend/tests/test_contract_compat_unions.py && .venv/bin/ruff format --check backend/tests/contract_compat.py backend/tests/test_contract_compat_unions.py
